scientific_integrity: Proof by explicit inverse branches, indicator-function transfer identities, exact cylinder integration, and elementary Markov/entropy arguments. Finite exact-rational tests are supplementary and not a continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: The eigenmode is proved only in a specified two-function subspace; at the upper endpoint the subspace becomes one-dimensional. The entropy statistic is one-step conditional entropy, not entropy rate. Only alpha in [4/3,3/2] is covered. The invariant density, constant one-digit frequencies and the endpoint Markov chain predate this result; equivalent unindexed work cannot be excluded.
title: A transfer-mode collapse and hidden digit memory on the symmetric-doubling frequency plateau
